Aruna.note: Charioteer of Surya, elder brother of Garuda; father of the vulture-kings Jatayu and Sampati.

people.Jatayu: Vulture-king, son of Aruna; he gave his life trying to stop Ravana from carrying Sita away.
people.Sampati: Vulture-king, elder brother of Jatayu; his far sight found Sita in Lanka for Rama's searchers.

Vinata.note: Daughter of Daksha, wife of Kashyap; mother of the sun's charioteer Aruna and of Garuda.

Garuda.note: Son of Kashyap and Vinata; the mighty eagle who bears Vishnu.
